method: All seven saved workspace originals individually viewed through view_image with detail=original after generation; existing FPV and Ukraine scout originals viewed before generation. Read-only Pillow measurements are separately preserved.

rows.fullImageFinding: Round cream saucer, attached cyan north nose/canopy, two magenta stern sockets. Broad continuous mass; all visible appendages fit.

Broad manta/pentagon with cream shoulder wings and a closed magenta payload bay, cyan north nose. All visible tips fit, but substantial side margins are only 20 pixels (1.6% of canvas), below the requested margin.
Blocky H-shaped cargo barge: six cream cargo blocks in two rails and a central cyan bridge/nose. Rear magenta sockets and connected rails are complete.
Pointed delta/arrow, long cyan north canopy, swept cream fins with magenta tips, deeply notched forked stern. Complete silhouette; 36-pixel nose margin (2.9%) is below requested margin.
Asymmetric large right magenta annular spool, left cream square counterweight and a connected central cyan north nose. No trailing cable; spool is baked static artwork.
Blunt cream north armor bar, broad cyan visor, solid magenta center, two chunky rear outriggers with cyan sockets. Readable toy-robot/ram vocabulary, no impact effect.
Open square cage/frame with cyan structural cross, four large interior windows, magenta corner pads, cyan north canopy and two magenta stern sockets. No deployed trap or separate effect.

qualifications: No text, logos, copied game characters, baked speed trails or detached impact effects observed. This is a visual statement, not an exhaustive third-party similarity search.
North heading is visually proposed. Center pivot, stern sockets, spool/payload articulation and bank are future design proposals, not validated anchors or animation rigs.

Actual transparency includes many intermediate-alpha pixels. Low-alpha fringes reach an image edge in six originals; only substantial alpha>=128 bounds are inset for all seven. Do not describe the entire alpha support as cleanly padded.

Requested 16-color palette was not achieved; exact distinct RGBA counts are preserved in alpha-inspection.json. No palette reduction, resampling, background removal, cropping or image editing was performed.
No runtime registry, collision, ability, simulation, manifest or production build changes. Native CSS-size compositing is a separate follow-up record.
